full_judgment: 3. The plaintiffs' case, in short, is that the suit property described in the Schedule of the plaint originally belonged to Kangali Charan Kundu under landlord Mansur Ali Sheikh, after death of Kangali Charan suit property was settled to Narendra Kumar Roy who got the patta in the name of his wife Charubala. After death of Narendra Kumar, his son Sachindra Kumar Roy Chowdhury got the suit property, but SA record prepared in the name of Charubala and one Nur Jahan but ultimately, it was corrected in his name who exchanged the suit property with Indian migrants Sheikh Ali Hossain and Sheikh Akbar Ali. Sheikh Akbar Ali and others sold the suit property to Abdul Kader Khan. The plaintiff acquired 24 decimals of land out of 63 decimals by successive kabalas from Abdul Kader Khan beginning from 20-5-1986; accordingly, records of right was prepared in their names but defendant claimed the land by virtue of a registered deed of transfer. Hence the suit.
